metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.5 · 1976 · The Omen
metas.description: An American ambassador to Britain and his wife may be raising the Antichrist.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.2 · 1978 · Damien: Omen II
metas.description: Damien the Antichrist, now about to turn thirteen years old, finally learns of his destiny under the guidance of an unholy disciple of Satan. Meanwhile dark forces begin to eliminate all those who suspect the child's true identity.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.5 · 1981 · The Final Conflict
metas.description: The now adult Antichrist plots to eliminate his future divine opponent while a cabal of monks plot to stop him.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 3.9 · 1991 · Omen IV: The Awakening
metas.description: Two attorneys adopt a mysterious orphan girl as their daughter, unaware she is the new Antichrist, next in line to Damien Thorn.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 5.5 · 2006 · The Omen
metas.description: An American official realizes that his young son may literally be the Devil incarnate.
